description: we are young people enthusiastic about space
summary: Our project is a children's book about the Opportunity rover and its journey trough mars in the 15 years of its lifetime, in the book we personified the rover and gave him a personality to make the narrative more engaging to the younger audience. We believe that the romanticization of the rover's story could spark an interest from this younger audience to research more about not only the rover but space.
details: Our project is a children's book with the aim to spark interest in space, our book is about the Opportunity rover, the main POV of the book is Opportunity and the book narrates his journey through mars. The tools we used were Canva, Word and ChatGPT(to create all the images on the book). Our project personified Opportunity and gave him a personality. The language used in the book is mainly directed to the understanding to this younger audience.
